title: Scenic Guide Digital Human
summary: A competition prototype to which I contributed, combining text and voice interaction, route guidance, attraction narration, and knowledge management for a scenic-area visitor experience.

facts.publicText: A competition prototype to which I contributed, combining text and voice interaction, route guidance, attraction narration, and knowledge management for a scenic-area visitor experience.
